title: Juicy Roasted Norwegian Chickpea Stir-fry
description: An earthy and indulgent dish featuring roasted chickpeas in a dash-friendly sauce that's perfect for lunch or dinner.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add finely chopped onion, minced garlic, and ground cumin. Sauté for about 2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in chicken broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for about 10 minutes, allowing flavors to meld together.
Stir in roasted chickpeas and finely chopped parsley. Cook for an additional 5 minutes or until the chickpeas are heated through and well coated with the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
